review_notes: cook time for peanuts approx. 15-20 min; total cook time for sauce approx. 20 min; servings estimated
title: Peanut Sauce for Satay (Kuah Kacang)
description: A rich, glossy peanut sauce for satay or nasi impit — made from scratch by dry-roasting half a kilo of peanuts then cooking them down in a spiced blended paste.
description_ms: Kuah kacang yang berkilat dan kaya rasa untuk satay atau nasi impit — dibuat dari awal dengan memanggang setengah kilo kacang tanah dan memasaknya dalam pes rempah.
steps: Dry-roast 500 g peanuts in a pan over low heat for 15–20 minutes until the skins loosen; cool and rub off skins.
Blend 70% of the peanuts finely; blend the remaining 30% coarsely.
Blend 4 onions, 3 lemongrass stalks, a knob each of galangal and ginger, 3 candlenuts, 6 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp dried shrimp together.
Heat a generous amount of oil; fry the blend with 5 tbsp blended chilli until the oil separates.
Add the blended peanuts; the mixture will look dry — add water and continue cooking.
Alternate between adding water and cooking down (repeat several times over about 20 minutes) until the peanuts are soft.
Season with 3 small blocks palm sugar, salt, seasoning powder and 0.5 tbsp tamarind paste.
Continue cooking until the sauce is glossy and the oil floats on top. Serve with ketupat or satay.
steps_ms: Panggang 500g kacang tanah dalam kuali tanpa minyak atas api perlahan selama 15-20 minit sehingga kulit mudah tertanggal; sejukkan dan gosok kulit keluar.
Blend 70% kacang secara halus; blend baki 30% secara kasar.
Blend 4 biji bawang merah, 3 batang serai, seketul masing-masing lengkuas dan halia, 3 biji buah keras, 6 ulas bawang putih dan 1 sudu udang kering bersama.
Panaskan banyak minyak masak; goreng blend bersama 5 sudu cili kisar sehingga pecah minyak.
Masukkan kacang yang dah di-blend; akan nampak kering — masukkan air dan sambung masak.
Bergilir-gilir antara tambah air dan masak sehingga kering (ulang beberapa kali lebih kurang 20 minit) sehingga kacang lembut.
Tambah 3 ketul kecil gula Melaka, garam, serbuk perasa dan setengah sudu pes asam jawa.
Sambung masak sehingga kuah berkilat dan minyak timbul di atas. Hidang dengan ketupat atau satay.
